conventions.convention: Diagram multiplication stacks the left factor above the right factor; every removed circle contributes δ.
Unnormalized closure is Tr_n(D)=δ^{c(D)}, including Tr_0(1)=1. Normalized closure is τ_n=δ^{-n}Tr_n and requires δ to be a unit.
The Hecke relation is (T_i-v)(T_i+1)=0. At q=exp(πi/ell), ell≥3, use v=q², δ=q+q⁻¹, T_i↦qU_i−1 and z₀=−1/(v+1).
Jones idempotent generators e_i=(T_i+1)/(v+1) belong to the localization inverting v+1; this localization cannot specialize to v=−1 over C.
Quantum integers satisfy [0]=0, [1]=1 and [r+1]=δ[r]−[r−1]. The recursive p_n requires [2],…,[n] to be units; it does not require [n+1] to be nonzero.
At the positive root the retained simple labels are 0,…,ell−2, with 0 the tensor unit. Fusion indices satisfy triangle inequalities, parity and c≤2ell−4−a−b.
The quantum self-dual cup/cap loop is −δ. The categorical ribbon comparison uses TL(−δ) with parity-corrected pivotal structure; positive-loop endomorphism algebras correspond by U_i=−e_i.

load_bearing.statement: For ell≥3, q=exp(πi/ell), v=q², δ=q+q⁻¹ and z₀=−1/(v+1), the assignment T_i↦qU_i−1 gives H(n)/J_n≅TL_n(C,δ), where J_n is generated by the six-term parabolic sums. The specialized Ocneanu trace vanishes on J_n and corresponds to τ_n=δ^{-n}Tr_n.

Over any commutative ring and loop value δ, closure is cyclic, Tr_{n+1}(x⊗1)=δTr_n(x), and for n≥1, Tr_{n+1}((x⊗1)U_n)=Tr_n(x). Closure also factors through the stated right partial trace, without division by δ.

Over a nonzero commutative ring with [2],…,[n] units, p_n is the unique identity-coefficient-one annihilating idempotent, has corner Rp_n, and satisfies ptr_n(p_n)=([n+1]/[n])p_{n−1} and Tr_n(p_n)=[n+1].

At q=exp(πi/ell), ell≥3, the embedded boundary ideal generated by p_{ell−1} equals the normalized closure pairing radical; its quotient has complete retained-path matrix blocks and the stated truncated fusion rule. At rank ell−1 the unreduced algebra is semisimple with a nonzero one-dimensional trace radical.

For every ell≥3, the full type-1 rank-one tilting negligible quotient is a finite semisimple ribbon category with simples T(0),…,T(ell−2), dimensions [a+1]_q and the displayed truncated fusion rule, including even ell.
